class.name: SoundFontPreset
class.brief_description: Stores the bank, program number, and name of a SoundFont instrument preset.
class.description:
SoundFontPreset represents an individual instrument preset contained in a SoundFont.
Each preset is identified by a bank number and a program number, along with a name describing the instrument or sound. These values can be used to identify and select instruments when working with a SoundFont through FluidSynthPlayer.
This class extends Resource, allowing preset information to be represented as a Godot resource.
